validate_config_dict_item: validate a config dictionary item against available attributes and collect errors
validate_required_attrs: validate that all required attributes are present in a config dict item
validate_attr_types: validate that config dict item attributes match their expected types
validate_insertion_files: validate that insertion file paths referenced in config attributes exist on disk
replace_path_to_file_with_its_content: replace a relative file path token with the content of the referenced file
